summary: Ambev S.A. filed a 6-K reporting board approval to cancel 279 million treasury common shares without capital reduction, reducing outstanding shares to 15.484 billion. The cancellation is a capital-return mechanism enhancing per-share metrics. The board unanimously approved an amended insider trading policy. A shareholder meeting will address the bylaw amendment. No price, premium, or advisor disclosed. The move signals ongoing capital management; watch for future buyback or dividend actions.
